description_en: Provides features for creating, deleting, updating, and querying hot word lists
description_zh: 提供热词词表的创建、删除、更新、查询功能
kebab_example: aliyun multimodaldialog vocabulary --action createVocabulary --vocabulary-name '热词表' --vocabulary text=张三 lang=zh type=contact_name --vocabulary-id a93b91141c0f422fa114af203f8b0000 --vocabulary-ids a93b91141c0f422fa114af203f8b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Vocabulary

fields.help_en:
The language of the hot word. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
fields.help_zh:
热词语种。
zh：中文
en：英语
fields.name: lang

fields.help_en: The hot word text. Each hot word can contain up to 15 Chinese characters or 7 English words. If a hot word contains both Chinese and English, the total number of Chinese characters and English letters cannot exceed 15
fields.help_zh: 热词文本。每个热词不超过15个汉字或7个英文单词。若热词同时含中文和英文，则汉字与英文字母总数不超过15个
fields.name: text

fields.help_en:
The type of the hot word. If you need to use hot words of types such as contacts in a conversation system, set this parameter. Otherwise, if you only need to use the hot word in ASR tasks, set this parameter to null or an empty string. Valid values:
contact_name: contact
fields.help_zh:
热词种类。如果需要在对话系统中使用联系人等类型的热词，需要设置该值。否则，如果只需要在asr任务中使用，可以将该值置为null或空字符串。
contact_name：联系人
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The hot word list. Required for creation. You can add up to 500 words to each hot word list
parameters.help_zh: 热词表，创建时必填。每个热词列表最多添加500个词
parameters.name: vocabulary

parameters.help_en: The hot word ID. Required for update and delete operations
parameters.name: vocabulary_id

parameters.help_en: The list of hot word IDs. Required for query operations
parameters.name: vocabulary_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the hot word list. Required for creation
parameters.help_zh: 热词表名称。创建时必填
parameters.name: vocabulary_name

vocabularyId.description_en: The hot word ID. This is the unique identifier generated by the create operation. You can pass this ID when establishing a conversation connection
vocabularyId.description_zh: 热词id。创建操作生成的热词唯一标识，在对话连接时可以传入此id

vocabularys.description_en: The list of hot words. When the request is a query operation, this list contains the hot words retrieved based on the specified hot word ID list
vocabularys.description_zh: 热词列表。请求为查询操作时，根据热词id列表查询操作到的热词列表

modifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time of the hot word list. This value is null if the corresponding hot word is not found
modifiedTime.description_zh: 热词表最新修改时间。查询不到对应热词时，该返回值为null

vocabulary.description_en: The hot word. This value is null if the corresponding hot word is not found
vocabulary.description_zh: 热词。热词表最新修改时间。查询不到对应热词时，该返回值为null

lang.description_en: The language of the hot word

type.description_en: The type of the hot word

vocabularyName.description_en: The name of the hot word list. This value is null if the corresponding hot word is not found
vocabularyName.description_zh: 热词表名称。查询不到对应热词时，该返回值为null
